crossRefs.note: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.
The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood…
Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”
Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Hail, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He…
But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

people.name: Amasa
people.line: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Joab said to Amasa, “Is it well with you, my brother?” Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
translations.bsb: “Are you well, my brother?” Joab asked Amasa. And with his right hand Joab grabbed Amasa by the beard to kiss him.
translations.kjv: And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.
translations.asv: And Joab said to Amasa, Is it well with thee, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with his right hand to kiss him.
